facts.statement: China and India signed a memorandum of understanding in 2002 under which China provides hydrological data on the Brahmaputra in the flood season.
facts.source: Ministry of External Affairs of India

facts.statement: The Zangmu hydropower station on the Yarlung Tsangpo began full operation in October 2015.

facts.statement: China approved a hydropower project on the lower reaches of the Yarlung Tsangpo in December 2024.

facts.statement: Construction of the lower Yarlung Tsangpo hydropower project began on 19 July 2025.
